postures._note: Written into docs/DESIGN.md; see openspec/specs/visual-design-system/ requirement 'Six design postures written into team documentation'
postures.primary-action-solid: Primary actions are solid accent color, NOT 135° gradients
postures.price-ink-or-accent: Prices use ink color or accent, NOT competing visual weight
postures.serif-fresh-not-trendy: Serif display conveys 'fresh / authentic', NOT generic trendy feel
postures.accent-at-most-twice: Single accent used consistently, AT MOST twice per screen
postures.state-only-not-brand: State colors ONLY for state, NOT brand storytelling
